evidence.reason: The current implementation still uses `\d` in the timestamp regex at line 100. In Python `str` regexes, `\d` matches Unicode decimal digits, so a timestamp using non-ASCII digits can pass this "exact UTC timestamp" check and be parsed by `strptime`. Because the event id is a digest of canonical JSON containing `occurred_at`, alternate spellings of the same instant produce different ids, undermining the canonical-evidence assumption. The proposed ASCII-only digit class fixes the defect.
